# Streaming stitch parity cases (issue #357), replayed by
# tests/test_stream_chunk.py (Python) and cpp/tests/stream_session_test.cpp
# (native): both must produce every expected line exactly.
#
# stitch <name>            stitch_words(committed, new) with max_overlap 24
#   < committed words      (a bare "<" or ">" is an empty side)
#   > new words
#   = expected words
# suppress <name> <seconds>   suppress_loops(words, seconds)
#   < words
#   = expected words
# stream <name> <chunk_s> <overlap_s>   ChunkStreamer.flush over synthetic audio
#   audio <seconds> <amplitude> ...     constant-amplitude segments, 16 kHz
#   tx <kind> <start_s> <length_s> <text...>   the transcriber's answer for a
#                                       call (kind "*" = any); "tx * * * <text>"
#                                       answers every other call. A matching
#                                       line answers once if another matching
#                                       line follows it; text BUSY answers
#                                       busy (no text)
#   = expected final words
#   calls <kind>@<start_s>+<length_s> ...      every transcribe call, in order

stitch agreeing_overlap
< he tells us that at this festive season of the year
> season of the year with christmas and roast beef
= he tells us that at this festive season of the year with christmas and roast beef

stitch overlap_cut_in_the_middle
< one two three four five six seven
> three four five six seven eight nine
= one two three four five six seven eight nine

stitch disagreeing_cut_off_edges
< season of the year with christmas and roast bee
> ear with christmas and roast beef looming before us
= season of the year with christmas and roast beef looming before us

stitch common_phrase_far_from_the_boundary
< mister quilter is the apostle of the middle classes and we are glad to welcome his gospel nor is mister quilter's manner less interesting than his matter.
> He tells us that at this festive season of the year, with Christmas and roast
= mister quilter is the apostle of the middle classes and we are glad to welcome his gospel nor is mister quilter's manner less interesting than his matter. He tells us that at this festive season of the year, with Christmas and roast

stitch repeated_phrase_spanning_the_boundary
< replied the new king. I hope he doesn't work too hard, said Shaggy.
> He doesn't work at all. In fact, there's nothing he can do
= replied the new king. I hope he doesn't work too hard, said Shaggy. He doesn't work at all. In fact, there's nothing he can do

stitch pause_in_the_overlap
< less interesting than his matter.
> He tells us that at this
= less interesting than his matter. He tells us that at this

stitch empty_new_window
< keep these words
>
= keep these words

stitch empty_committed
<
> first words
= first words

stitch single_word_windows
< yes
> yes
= yes yes

stitch punctuation_never_matches
< -- ;;
> .. ,, word
= -- ;; .. ,, word

suppress loop_in_a_preview 12
< and then a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a so on
= and then a little bit of a little bit of a so on

suppress real_repetition_within_bound 2
< no no no no no I said no
= no no no no no I said no

suppress real_repetition_beside_a_loop 12
< no no no no no I said la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la la
= no no no no no I said la la

suppress over_bound_without_repeats 1
< w1 w2 w3 w4 w5 w6 w7 w8 w9 w10 w11 w12 w13 w14 w15
= w1 w2 w3 w4 w5 w6 w7 w8 w9 w10 w11
